featuredMedia.$comment: The live homepage embeds Vimeo 1198760040 with no poster, no stated captions and no transcript. Version 2 will not assert accessibility facts nobody has verified, so this migrates as a picture that links to the video, which is what the section's own body text already tells the reader to do. Turning it back into an embedded player is a content decision, not an engineering one: see docs/CONTENT-TODO.md for the three things it needs. The still and the metadata below are real, taken from Vimeo's own oEmbed response on 2026-09-05.
